items.title: Fans book days off as GTA VI launch week arrives
items.summary: Reuters reports launch-day time-off requests running about 13% above a normal November day, with about a third of Gen Z workers surveyed planning to take Thursday off, and Newzoo estimating at least $3.25 billion in first-week sales.

items.title: Six new screenshots show off Leonida's dynamic weather
items.summary: Rockstar gave The Weather Channel six new screenshots built around Leonida's weather — heavy rain in the Keys, sea fog over Vice City, a storm over the Pelican Valley swamps and a tropical storm at sea — and art VP Owen Shepherd says the system was rebuilt to feel localized, persistent and dynamic.

items.title: CNN calls GTA VI launch the year's biggest entertainment event
items.summary: CNN's Reliable Sources frames Thursday's launch as arguably the biggest media and entertainment event of the year, citing Sensor Tower preorder data and IGN co-founder Peer Schneider's view that the only question is how big GTA VI will be, not whether it will be a hit.

items.title: GTA VI hacker pleads guilty in London, three days before launch
items.summary: Arion Kurtaj, 21, pleaded guilty at Woolwich Crown Court to the 2022 Rockstar hack that leaked dozens of unfinished GTA VI clips, plus other Lapsus$ offences; he will be sentenced later, and Rockstar put its recovery cost at $5 million.

items.title: Game Awards nominations land Tuesday — before any GTA VI reviews
items.summary: Polygon notes The Game Awards nominations are announced at noon ET on November 17, a day before GTA VI reviews are expected on November 18 under Rockstar's usual day-before-launch pattern, with the eligibility cutoff on November 20.

items.title: Second mandatory pre-launch update is out — install it before Thursday
items.summary: A second pre-launch patch, version 01.002.001 at 602.5 MB on PS5, is rolling out to pre-loads and must be installed before GTA VI unlocks on November 19; Rockstar has not published patch notes for it.

items.title: Release week is here: USA Today's GTA VI primer covers editions, story and the score
items.summary: USA Today's launch-week explainer rounds up what to know before Thursday: Jason and Lucia's story, the $79.99 Standard and $99.99 Ultimate editions, the Justice-composed score album due December 11, and still no PC date from Rockstar.

items.title: Miami turns into Vice City for launch week
items.summary: AFP reports Miami is awash in neon-pink Vice City branding under a $3.9 million Miami-Dade County deal with Rockstar, with signs at the Heat's arena and the airport, murals downtown, and fans posing with a 'Welcome to Vice City' car on Miami Beach.

items.title: Madden NFL 27 begs players: don't delete us to make room for GTA VI
items.summary: EA added a Vice City-styled 'Don't Delete!' pop-up in Madden NFL 27 as players clear space for GTA VI's up-to-212 GB pre-load, teasing something in Madden for November 17, two days before launch.

items.title: Guardian hands-on: Jason and Lucia start small, and their bond is yours to keep or lose
items.summary: The Guardian visited Rockstar North and saw the game played live: the pair begin with low-end cars and basic locks, plan heists carefully, and can nurture or neglect their relationship, which Rockstar calls a first attempt to encourage empathy in GTA.

items.title: Free GTA VI codes up for grabs on Kick and Twitch
items.summary: Kick is giving away 10,000 Ultimate Edition codes through its Sunset Reward cases until December 7 for viewers who watch streams, and Twitch runs a similar code giveaway from launch day, November 19, through November 30.
Take-Two's November 9 results list GTA VI for November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and CEO Strauss Zelnick told IGN it is not going to be delayed again.
items.title: Launch date locked: Thursday, November 19, 2026

items.summary: Rockstar moved pre-load up to November 10 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Boxed copies hold a download code (no disc) and reached stores November 12.
items.title: Pre-load is live now — clear up to 212 GB

items.summary: The latest Rockstar Newswire post (November 5) opens a launch gallery of new screenshots from Vice City and beyond, two weeks out from release.
items.title: Rockstar posts the GTA VI Launch Gallery

items.summary: Rockstar's Miami-flavoured Instagram campaign dropped a second in-game clip on November 14 — cars rounding a busy Vice City corner, days before launch.
items.title: 'Only in Dade' clips are real in-game footage
